description: This file defines the AppointmentsRepository class responsible for managing appointment data interactions with a backend API, including fetching user appointments and creating new appointments.

classes.name: AppointmentsRepository
classes.description: Repository class that interfaces with the backend to fetch and create appointment data using ApiClient.

methods.name: getMyAppointments
methods.description: Fetches the current user's appointments, attempting '/appointments/my' first, and falling back to '/appointments' upon failure.

methods.name: createAppointment
methods.description: Creates a new appointment with specified doctorId and datetime, optionally including a reason.
